problem: Rapid urbanization in India has led to inadequate centralized sewerage systems, making them unviable (due to high costs, long gestation periods, and water intensity) especially in small towns and urban peripheries, while expertise in non-networked sanitation systems is extremely sparse.
solution: A three-week Certificate Course on Non-Networked Sanitation Management (CCSM) offered by Xavier Center for Urban Management and Governance (XUMG) with support from SCBP of NIUA.
technology: Non-networked (decentralized) sanitation technologies, including Faecal Sludge Management (FSM), decentralized wastewater treatment systems, and integrated low-cost sanitation solutions.
outcome: Participants gain practical skills in planning, financing, procurement, operations, and performance assessment of non-networked sanitation systems, and receive a Certificate in Non-Networked Sanitation Management.
